pages.text: $(bold)T1:$() Iron, Copper, Brass, Tin, Bronze. No diamonds in Overworld.$(br)$(bold)T2:$() Steel, Manasteel, Signalum, Lumium, Steeleaf, Ironwood, Fiery. Limited diamond via expensive recipes.$(br)$(bold)T3:$() Diamond (full), Terrasteel, Elementium, Enderium, Osmium, Refined Obsidian.$(br)$(bold)T4:$() Netherite, Gaia Ingots, Dragon Scales/Hearts, Antimatter, Atomic Alloy.$(br2)$(bold)Cross-Tier Peek:$() Transmutation (32-64 ingots = 1 next-tier) and boss drops (5-15% chance for 1-3 next-tier materials) give early tastes without breaking gates.
